title: 北京海兰信数据科技股份有限公司 关于海底数据中心阶段性测试成果及项目进展的公告 (Highlander UDC phased test results, 2021-01-11)
notes: Official listed-company disclosure (cninfo, SSE 300065, Announcement 2021-006). UDC test module deployed 2020-11-29 at Zhuhai, recovered 2021-01-08. Per Qingdao Huanhai 《海底数据中心海洋生态环境影响评估报告》: max outlet temperature rise only 2°C, impact confined to small area around equipment, basically no negative effect on marine organisms. Tsinghua Univ. lab: single-module PUE 1.076. Operator-commissioned assessment, not independent peer-reviewed; no ecosystem distortion or fisher-displacement finding. This is the closest match to the 'supposed 2020 Chinese study' (deployment 2020, results published 2021-01-11).
